items.description: Identification as a non-inferiority trial in the title
Structured summary of trial design, methods, results, and conclusions, with a focus on non-inferiority
Scientific background and explanation of rationale, including the choice of the non-inferiority margin
Specific objectives or hypotheses related to non-inferiority
Description of trial design (such as parallel, factorial) including allocation ratio
Important changes to methods after trial commencement (such as eligibility criteria), with reasons
Settings and locations where the data were collected
The interventions for each group with sufficient details to allow replication, including how and when they were actually administered
Completely defined pre-specified primary and secondary outcome measures, including how and when they were assessed
Any changes to trial outcomes after the trial commenced, with reasons
How sample size was determined, including the non-inferiority margin
When applicable, explanation of any interim analyses and stopping guidelines

Statistical methods used to compare groups for primary and secondary outcomes, including the analysis population (e.g., intention-to-treat, per-protocol) and the statistical test used to assess non-inferiority

For each primary and secondary outcome, results for each group, and the estimated effect size and its precision (such as 95% confidence interval), including the results of the non-inferiority analysis
Interpretation consistent with results, balancing benefits and harms, and considering other relevant evidence, with a focus on the non-inferiority conclusion
